opinion.title: Second opinion
opinion.label.same-agent: the same agent in a fresh conversation, which is not an independent reading
opinion.label.maker-not-declared: an agent whose maker is not declared, whose reading is not counted as another maker's
opinion.says.waits-chain: It is asked once this chain's last step here is done: quest #{{later}} still works here, so one opinion reads the chain's whole work.
opinion.says.not-asked: It is asked at the driver's next look, once nothing before it holds the work.
opinion.says.readingMinutes: Being read by {{who}}, {{label}}, for at most {{minutes}} minutes.
opinion.says.with-session: The working session is answering {{count}} finding by {{who}}.
opinion.says.with-session_other: The working session is answering {{count}} findings by {{who}}.
opinion.says.read-again: Read again by {{who}}: the commits made in answer.
opinion.says.disputed: {{count}} finding by {{who}} is disputed: a must the working session did not fix and no recheck withdrew.
opinion.says.disputed_other: {{count}} findings by {{who}} are disputed: each a must the working session did not fix and no recheck withdrew.
opinion.says.commits-since: {{count}} commit since was not read by another agent: one pass and one recheck are spent for this work.
opinion.says.commits-since_other: {{count}} commits since were not read by another agent: one pass and one recheck are spent for this work.
opinion.says.pressAnswers: Your Accept, or your Reviewed where a look is required, answers them.
opinion.says.noPress: No press of yours is coming, since the work lands by itself: go on anyway, send it back or ask again.
opinion.says.required: The rule requires one, so the work waits for you.
opinion.says.optional: The rule does not require one, so nothing waits for it.
opinion.says.settled: Settled: {{who}} read it, and nothing it found is disputed.
opinion.says.settledNothing: Settled: {{who}} raised nothing in what it read.
opinion.says.anyway: You went on without a settled second opinion.
opinion.says.myself: You looked at it yourself in place of another agent's reading.
opinion.says.answered: Your press answered what the second opinion left unsettled.
opinion.says.unread: Whether this work waits for a second opinion could not be read, so nothing lands until it can be.
opinion.why.no-reviewer: no listed reviewer of another maker is installed
opinion.why.cooling: every listed reviewer of another maker is cooling
opinion.why.coolingUntil: every listed reviewer of another maker is cooling until {{time}}, when the driver asks again
opinion.why.signed-out: no listed reviewer of another maker has an account signed in
opinion.why.not-independent: no listed reviewer is another maker's agent
opinion.why.out-of-time: {{who}} ran out of its minutes before it said one
opinion.why.other: no listed reviewer of another maker could read it
opinion.toPerson.recheck: Its findings went to you: a recheck's findings never go back to the working session by themselves.
opinion.toPerson.conversation: Its findings went to you: the work was a conversation's, which another agent's findings do not reach by themselves.
opinion.toPerson.other: Its findings went to you, since the working session could not go on with them.
opinion.tier.agent: Read by another agent: its findings are claims, not facts.
opinion.answer.fixed: Fixed at `{{commit}}`, by the working session's account
opinion.counts.fix-unknown: Fixed, its commit said, but its tree holds no commit by that name
opinion.counts.fix-not-after: Fixed, its commit said, but that commit is not after the work the other agent read
opinion.counts.fix-off-branch: Fixed, its commit said, but that commit is not on the session's branch
opinion.counts.fix-unread: Fixed, its commit said, but git could not read its tree to check it
opinion.ask.anywayTitle: Go on without a settled second opinion
opinion.ask.anyway: Go on without a settled second opinion: {{unsettled}} stays so, and the landing's next step follows. Nothing lands by this press. Your words, if you give any, are kept with it.
opinion.ask.words: why, if you want to say
opinion.ask.myselfTitle: Your own reading in place of another agent's
opinion.ask.myself: Record that you read this work yourself, in place of another agent's reading. Your words, if you give any, are kept with it.
opinion.ask.sendBackTitle: Send it back: say what to put right
opinion.ask.sendBack: Your words go to session {{session}} as its next turn, in its own conversation.
opinion.ask.stop: Stop {{who}}'s reading: it gives no opinion, and the work then waits as one with none.
opinion.accept.answers: Accepting answers what the second opinion left unsettled: {{unsettled}}.
opinion.said.sentBack: Your words went to session {{session}} as its next turn.
opinion.session.title: Second opinion
